Admin.//: Whether /Admin answers. The site's words come from wwwroot/_data/*.json either way; the database holds revision history and the login, nothing the public site reads.

Proxy.//: Addresses of the proxies in front of this app, e.g. [ "127.0.0.1" ] for nginx on the same machine. Only from these is X-Forwarded-For believed, and that header is what tells the contact form's rate limit one visitor from another. Leave empty when Kestrel is reached directly.
